# Pitboard

> Switch your AI coding tools between your own accounts without signing out.

Pitboard works with Claude Code and OpenAI's Codex CLI on macOS and Linux, and with Claude Desktop on macOS.

Install the command line on macOS or Linux:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://usepitboard.com/install.sh | sh
```
